column1: # Variant -> covering test, checked by scripts/check-variant-coverage.py (POOT-1221). Hand-committed,
# never generated from a run. `covered` rows name a #[test] fn whose body names the variant; `gap` rows are
# variants no test names yet, each a refusal nobody has watched fire. A new variant needs a row; a gap that
# gains a covering test must be promoted. `scripts/check-variant-coverage.py --suggest` proposes rows.
